entries.name: Bible Study Fellowship (BSF)
entries.summary: A free, interdenominational Bible study open to all. The BSF Study runs 30 weeks: daily questions on your own, a weekly small-group discussion, teaching from a trained leader and lesson notes. Groups meet in person or online, and the WordGo app lets friends study at their own pace.
entries.cost: Free (BSF calls its study free and open to all)
entries.jacksonville: BSF's group finder listed 26 groups around Jacksonville on 2026-10-08 (6 men's, 20 women's; in person and online), for example at Mandarin Baptist Church, Westside Baptist Church and Christian Family Chapel.

entries.name: Community Bible Study (CBS)
entries.summary: Classes that explore the Bible together, for every age and stage of life, from toddlers and teens to single and married adults. Classes are coed, men's or women's, and many offer children's groups.
entries.cost: Each class sets a registration fee. CBS says giving is voluntary, people who cannot contribute may attend freely, and registration scholarships are always available.
entries.jacksonville: The class finder (ZIP 32202) listed Jacksonville South FL classes (Main and Saint Johns), plus Fleming Island, Callahan and Amelia Island, on 2026-10-08.

entries.name: Precept Ministries International
entries.summary: Founded by Kay and Jack Arthur in 1970 to engage people in relationship with God through knowing His Word. Groups use the Precept inductive Bible study method, led by trained discussion leaders, in person or online; you can also study on your own.
entries.cost: No group fee is stated on its pages; members use a study workbook, sold in Precept's shop, and the first lesson of each study can be downloaded free. Some groups list extra fees on their own page.
entries.jacksonville: The group finder (within 100 miles of ZIP 32202) listed 8 in-person groups on 2026-10-08. The nearest was in Fernandina Beach; the others were in Gainesville, Daytona Beach and The Villages. None was in Jacksonville itself.

entries.name: Stonecroft Ministries
entries.summary: A ministry that exists to see women reconciled to God through Jesus Christ. It offers small-group Bible studies, Women's Connection gatherings and prayer groups, locally in person and online (including weekly prayer calls on Zoom).
entries.cost: No group fee is stated. Stonecroft Bible Study guides are sold in its shop (for example, Aware cost $8.99 on 2026-10-08).
entries.jacksonville: The group locator (35-mile radius) listed one group on 2026-10-08: Orange Park FL Women's Connection, about 12 miles away.

entries.name: Good Morning Girls (Women Living Well)
entries.summary: A group of Christian women who keep each other accountable in their quiet times, reading through books of the Bible together. Women can study alone, in online groups (Facebook or Instagram, email or text) or in groups of about 4 to 12 that meet in homes or churches; groups regroup each season.
entries.cost: Not stated on the page checked. The site sells printed and digital study journals and offers a free printable habit tracker to email subscribers.

entries.name: InterVarsity Christian Fellowship/USA
entries.summary: A campus community that helps students and faculty follow Jesus with their whole lives, for the rest of their lives. It calls Bible study core to its ministry. Chapters serve undergraduates, graduate students and faculty.
entries.jacksonville: The chapter finder listed 42 Florida results on 2026-10-08, none at a Jacksonville school. InterVarsity notes that not all chapters can be listed publicly.

entries.name: The Navigators
entries.summary: A Christian ministry that shares the gospel of Jesus and helps people grow in Christ through Life-to-Life discipleship. It describes this as a commitment to walk with friends rather than a programme. Its ministries include college campuses (with one-on-one Bible studies), the military, workplaces and churches. A free email series, Digital Discipleship Journeys, is available online.
entries.jacksonville: The Collegiate Navigators campus map lists Florida State College at Jacksonville (Downtown and South) and the University of North Florida (checked 2026-10-08).

entries.name: Cru
entries.summary: A caring community passionate about connecting people to Jesus Christ, with local and global opportunities to learn, connect and go. Its site offers Bible studies for personal study and for groups, arranged by book, spiritual interest or topic, and a tool for finding Cru near you.

entries.name: Young Life
entries.summary: A mission devoted to introducing adolescents to Jesus Christ and helping them grow in their faith, among middle school, high school and college students. Young Life Campaigners is a weekly meeting for kids who want to learn more or grow in their faith through study, service and leadership.
entries.jacksonville: The finder lists local Young Life areas, not single groups. Searching Jacksonville, FL on 2026-10-08 returned Central, Arlington, Westside and Northwest Jacksonville, Jacksonville Beaches, YoungLives Jacksonville, Clay County and Ponte Vedra, among others.

entries.name: Moms in Prayer International
entries.summary: Gathers mothers to pray for their children and schools, so that every school in the world would be covered with prayer. Groups stay focused on prayer, begin and end on time, follow a biblical format that starts with an attribute of God, and keep what they pray about confidential.

entries.name: National Day of Prayer Task Force
entries.summary: Exists to mobilize unified public prayer for America on the National Day of Prayer, the first Thursday of May. It describes itself as a privately funded organization representing a Judeo-Christian expression of the national observance. Local gatherings, including virtual ones, are listed in its gathering search.
entries.jacksonville: No 2027 gatherings were listed for Jacksonville (or any of the other five cities) on 2026-10-08; the next observance is Thursday, May 6, 2027.

entries.name: 9Marks Church Search
entries.summary: 9Marks helps pastors, future pastors and church members build healthy churches. Its Church Search lists churches by location. 9Marks says a listing is not an endorsement, and while it rebuilds the tool it is not taking new applications.
entries.jacksonville: Searching Jacksonville, FL on 2026-10-08 returned 30 churches, for example Shiloh Church, Redemption Church and Sovereign Grace Baptist Church.

entries.name: The Gospel Coalition Church Directory
entries.summary: A directory of churches with an advanced search by distance (1 to 50 miles), denomination, affiliation, ministries and service times; churches add themselves. TGC's mission is to help renew and unify the contemporary church in the ancient gospel.

entries.name: Acts 29
entries.summary: A global network of churches bound together by relationship, theology and church planting. It stands in the tradition of historic evangelical confessionalism, affirms the Lausanne Covenant with five theological distinctives, and embraces the sovereignty of God's grace in saving sinners. Its church finder searches by location.
entries.jacksonville: Within 25 miles of Jacksonville on 2026-10-08 the finder listed 7 churches: six Church of Eleven22 campuses and Gather Church in St. Augustine.

entries.name: Founders Ministries Church Search
entries.summary: Founders Ministries works for the recovery of the gospel and the biblical reformation of local churches. It recognises the Second London Baptist Confession (1689) and the Abstract of Principles. Churches in its search list themselves voluntarily, agreeing with Founders' values, and Founders says it cannot evaluate or endorse each one.
entries.jacksonville: Within 50 miles of Jacksonville on 2026-10-08 the search returned 11 churches, for example Covenant Church of Jacksonville, Sovereign Grace Baptist Church and Changed By Grace Church.

entries.name: Confessional Baptist Association (CBA)
entries.summary: A national association of churches that subscribe to the Second London Baptist Confession of Faith (1689). Every member church fully subscribes to it. Its member list is arranged by state. (arbca.com now redirects to this site.)
entries.jacksonville: The member list on 2026-10-08 had no church in Florida or Georgia. Its one North Carolina church is in Angier, about 150 miles from Charlotte.
